PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday APRIL 12, 2018
07:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair French
Commissioner Aleman, Avery, and Ward
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of March 8, 2018
Minutes
8. Public Hearings
8A. Finding of Consistency with the General Plan
City of Palmdale with Caltrans, Applicant
A request for a finding of consistency with the General Plan and adoption of the Mitigated Negative Declaration for improvements on 10th Street West and the SR-14 interchange from just south of Rancho Vista Boulevard to Avenue O-4.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-011 setting forth a finding that the State Route (SR-14), 10th Street West Widening / Interchange project is consistent with the goals, policies, and objectives of the City of Palmdale General Plan based on the findings within the draft Resolution, find that the proposed project will not result in a significant impact on the environment, and adopt the associated Mitigate Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program. Megan Taggart, Senior Planner
Finding of Consistency with the General Plan
8B. Conditional Use Permit 17-021
JY Waffle, Inc., Applicant
A request to establish a Type 47 (On-Sale General) alcoholic beverage control license for a bona fide restaurant within an existing 6,093 square foot building located at 4611 East Avenue S.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-014 approving a request to establish a Type 47 (On-Sale General) alcoholic beverage control license for a bona fide restaurant (Waffle Kitchen) and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
CUP 17-021
9. Staff Communications Development Updates
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
10. Planning Commission Communications
11. Adjournment to the regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, May 10, 2018, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale Chimbole Cultural Center Ballroom
